name: Dreams of Freedom
description: Begoña Montes is a woman who lives trapped in a toxic marriage and seeks the long-awaited freedom in Spain in 1958.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Begoña and Jesús are happily in love when Andrés returns home to the 'De la Reina', revolutionizing the family situation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After the collapse, Damián is seriously ill and tells his sons what to do with the factory if he is no longer there, a decision with which Jesús does not agree.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Luz saves Don Damián's life, and he decides to hire her at the factory, even though Jesús still doesn't see eye to eye. Meanwhile, the employees refuse to work until it's safe.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Begoña lies to Jesús about a call she receives and he reveals a face that his wife had previously unknown, and the affinity between Begoña and Andrés grows.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jesús reveals to his family that Begoña is pregnant, and she is upset; she hasn't confirmed it yet. Meanwhile, Andrés announces his engagement to María.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jesús refuses to give Lázaro any money and blames Digna for the fact that her son Valentín killed his wife and the mother of his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Begoña discovers she's not pregnant and tells Andrés. While she's thinking about how to tell Jesús, he receives a call saying his daughter, Julia, has been kidnapped.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Andrés and Begoña go out in search of Julia without telling Jesús, who doesn't want to alert the Civil Guard. After Carmen and Tasio's breakup, he has a date with Claudia.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Begoña and Andrés save Julia, while Jesús meets with Lázaro to deliver the ransom, which leads to a confrontation between the two. María arrives at the De la Reinas's house.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Begoña tells Jesús that she's not pregnant, which intensifies his anger after learning that his wife participated in the search for Julia. Andrés also introduces María to the family.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Begoña helps Andrés with his rehabilitation, and María sees his complicity. Andrés's perfume will be the company's new star product, but Jesús isn't happy.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Begoña suspects Jesús is lying to her and hiding something. She needs money to transfer her aunt to another school. Claudia breaks up with Tasio after standing him up the day before.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Dinner time arrives, and Luz unexpectedly shows up, a surprise for Luis. Jesús shows up drunk, and Luis confronts Jesús. The attraction between Begoña and Andrés grows.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jesús tells Begoña that Valentín killed his wife; they were in a relationship. Andrés pays for Begoña's aunt's stay at the sanatorium and tries to be honest with her.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Begoña begins to understand her husband's pain and asks Andrés to stay away from her. Marta asks Luis to return to the company. Some thugs trample Tasio over the debt.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Luis advises his cousin Andrés to give himself a chance with María, but Andrés rebuts him. Isidro suffers a fainting spell, but doesn't want to tell his daughter so as not to worry her.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Andrés tells María the truth about his father Duque's death. María is shocked and this increases when she sees a drawing of Begoña on her boyfriend's pad, she makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Begoña asks Andrés to take care of María and not let her go; their relationship is impossible. Meanwhile, Jesús makes Begoña late for work, and Luz gets upset.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Jesús reacts violently against Begoña in an argument and Begoña and Andrés have a brief rapprochement.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The essential perfume De la Reina is launched, and a journalist, Celia, takes notice of Luis. Jesús and Begoña reconcile.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Jesús wants to change the French lavender supplier, but Damián is opposed. Begoña reveals to Jesús that she saw him in the attic in front of Clotilde's portrait.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Begoña reveals to Jesús that she saw him in the attic in front of Clotilde's portrait. Jesús goes up to the attic with her: that is his past, but she is his present.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: After Andrés attacks Jesús, Damián cannot help but take matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Gema, fed up with being relegated to household chores, makes a decision. Andrés is still hurting after Begoña's rejection. One misstep by Jesús could cause everything to spiral downward.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Jesús tries to convince Begoña that there's nothing going on between him and Elena. Fina receives a visit from someone very important at the colony.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jesús lies to his wife, explaining that he had a brief affair with Elena in the past. Jesús apologizes to his wife, but she refuses.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Begoña's rejection. One misstep by Jesús could cause everything to spiral downward.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Begoña has a dream that makes her reconsider her feelings toward Jesús. Elena makes a decision that could have serious consequences for her former boss.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: It seems that Tasio's redemption is slowly taking effect, although when Marta realizes that Damián did not fire him in the end, she asks her father for an explanation.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Jesús is willing to do anything to make Begoña reconsider, but after what happened with Elena, she is clear about her position and won't budge.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Damián puts Luis's request to the board to a vote and the majority vote is yes, however, Jesús flies into a rage and gives an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Jesús discovers that his wife has cheated on him, has not been on any home visits or at the clinic, increasing his rage.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Jesús reproaches his wife: he knows she's lying to him. Who is that woman in the psychiatric hospital? After Damián's decision, Luis feels dejected, and Joaquín encourages him.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Damián unmasks Don Agustín and his donation scheme, taking advantage of money that is being donated to charity.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Luis doesn't understand Jesús's hatred for the Merino family. Digna and Joaquín, who know the true reasons for his resentment, suffer.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Marta confronts Fina about her relationship with Gaspar. Mateo is determined to prove that Don Agustín is a thief. Begoña and Jesús's marriage is once again in jeopardy.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Fina is now ready to start something more serious with Marta. Mateo seems to have cleared up his doubts about Don Agustín, but an unexpected visit makes him question his intentions.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The marriage between Begoña and Jesús is in danger again when he finds out that, contrary to what she said, she did tell someone her aunt's secret.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Marta, affected by the absence at the wedding of the woman she loves, reconsiders her relationship with her and takes an important step.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Unaware of what's happening between Marta and Fina, Carmen believes her boss has stopped valuing her. After the discovery about her mother, Begoña hesitates to share the information with Jesús.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Begoña doesn't dare tell Jesús the truth about Mercedes.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Fina makes a confession to Marta about Carmen, which Marta doesn't know how to handle.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: While Jesús, when inquiring about Mercedes's illness, sees risks for her future children, Begoña is deeply hurt to see her husband distant and cold.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Isidro misinterprets the love relationship his daughter is beginning.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: The conversation Isidro overheard between his daughter and Carmen continues to drive the driver crazy, as he confronts a cornered Fina.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: While Carmen and Tasio continue dealing with Ángela, Claudia feels strange about her friends' wedding.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Isidro, who still hasn't accepted Fina's homosexuality, reveals a harsh truth to her.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Begoña is angry with Jesús for visiting her mother behind her back. María wants to leave the charity, but she doesn't want to disappoint Andrés.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: After what happened with Mateo, Damián takes a stand against his son Jesús, who in turn is angry with Begoña for having turned to Andrés.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Begoña discovers something important about the book she found in the attic. Jesús continues to feel distant from his father.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Jesús confronts Begoña, believing she's the one having trouble conceiving. Ángela believes Damián should tell Tasio the truth.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Claudia is very afraid to tell anyone she's pregnant. Tasio is worried about knowing who his biological father really is.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Jesús decides to investigate his paternity. Luis decides to set limits on his relationship with Luz. Marta, following Damián's warnings, takes things a step further with Jaime.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Marta meets Fina to go to Madrid and give free rein to their love. Jesús, now that he knows the truth, begins to treat Julia differently.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Jaime begins to suspect that something is wrong in his marriage and confronts Marta. María is frustrated by the lack of success the flea market has had.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Jaime begins to suspect that something is wrong in his marriage and confronts Marta.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The relationship between Jesús and Julia remains strained, and Begoña, trying to help, confesses a dark secret to her husband.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: The thief flees after stabbing Fina. Along the way, he also wounds Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Begoña watches over Jesús during his recovery from the accident, but he, stubborn, insists that he is fine.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Joaquín sees Gonzalo in a strange situation and begins to distrust him.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: María is worried about not having controlled Julia after her escape to the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Andrés has a risky plan to solve the lavender problem and must convince his father and brothers.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Tasio makes a proposal to Carmen when he learns of Claudia's plans for her son.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Fina wants to open up to Isidro about her relationship, but he still finds it difficult to accept her.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: María works hard to make a good impression on the Ortegas. Claudia and Carmen must make an important decision. Luis and Luz have second thoughts after their kiss.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Fina is devastated after her breakup with Marta. Just when it seemed all was lost for Begoña, Elena reappears, determined to meet with her.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Jesús begins to suspect Begoña. María confirms her suspicions about Sebastián. Isidro worries about Fina. Gema is excited when Joaquín apologizes.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Jesús, deeply hurt by Begoña's suspicions, tells her to talk to Digna about Valentín. Gema, discouraged by María's refusal to attend the dinner, leans on Joaquín for support.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Begoña, devastated, reconnects with Andrés. Jaime has vision problems. Jesús makes a brutal confession to Damián.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Andrés wants to talk to Begoña about the conversation they had the night before, but she refuses.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: María, alarmed by Gema's words, decides to look for evidence of Andrés's deception.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Gema, increasingly frustrated with her marriage, has a heated argument with Digna.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Jaime sounds Luz out by inviting her to a meeting with professors from Barcelona.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Claudia tells Carmen and Tasio that she will have her child alone, but he is not at all satisfied with her decision.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Jaime feels under a lot of pressure now that he knows he has a tumor and will soon be unable to practice. Andrés's departure is imminent, but Begoña asks him for help one last time.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Begoña confronts Jesús after her discovery, causing everything to unravel. Fina feels neglected by Marta, who is very busy with the launch of the new product.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: While some fugitives Andrés, Begoña and Julia find a refuge where they will not be discovered, Damián and Jesús continue on their trail.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Andrés manages to contact Luz, who agrees to help Begoña. Jesús and Damián continue searching without success, but Damián finds a clue that could help them.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Damián is getting closer to finding Begoña's whereabouts, who, in turn, remains in the cabin in very serious condition after being shot.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Back home, Begoña is between life and death. Andrés is ready to denounce Jesús, but Damián has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Luis, who doesn't know whether he should focus on his new love interest, Sara, and forget about Luz, talks to the doctor, who clears up his doubts.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Begoña, defeated, decides not to report Jesús. Sara bonds with Luis and gets to know Digna and Luz a little better.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: After Isidro's heart attack, Fina refuses to accept that her father might die. Gema meets a gentleman in Madrid who shows interest in her. Luis and Sara grow closer.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Luz is saddened to learn that Luis is moving forward in his relationship with Sara. María can't help but tell the whole family that she's pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Fina asks Jaime and Luz for help to save her father, but they have no hope.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Jaime threatens Marta with revealing his condition, and she, very distressed, speaks to Fina.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Carmen and Claudia take action on the matter of Don Agustín's robbery.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Isidro rejects the treatment proposed by Jaime, to the disappointment of Fina, who asks Marta for help.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Agustín rebukes Carmen and Claudia for their accusation, and Tasio asks his wife for explanations for the same reason.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Mercedes begins to live in the house, to the surprise of the De la Reina family, and especially to Damián, who does not understand his son's strategy.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Andrés discovers that Begoña is slacking off on Jesús. Begoña has a revealing conversation with her mother.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Begoña, after speaking with Mercedes, tries to get Jesús to open up to her. Marta supports Fina, but struggles for not being able to do so more lovingly, since Jaime is present.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Begoña realizes that to survive, she must go along with Jesús. Andrés senses their rapport and makes an important decision.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Andrés continues investigating Clotilde's death, and Luz gives him valuable information. María fears that Andrés will catch on to her lie when he wants to sleep with her.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Andrés is willing to tell Digna that Julia is his granddaughter. Ernesto discovers who Gema really is and is willing to be with her anyway.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Jesús begins to grow impatient with Mercedes' presence in the house. Isidro once again urges Damián to be honest with the person he loves: Digna.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: After the confrontation with Mercedes, Jesús denies what happened and strengthens ties with Damián upon learning that he blackmailed Begoña.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Jesús sets his plan against Mercedes in motion, causing her to disappear. Gema threatens Ernesto: if he talks to Joaquín, she'll report him to the police.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Given what happened with Mercedes, Begoña decides she should return to the sanatorium. Marta and Fina decide to try again after Jaime's words.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: After Mercedes's departure, Begoña is devastated and decides to return to work. Damián invites Tasio hunting and defends his relationship with him in front of Jesús.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: A major newspaper is going to feature the family. Marta and Fina remind themselves that they must be careful in public about their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: During the report, Jesús manages to get the journalist to focus solely on him and Begoña. Begoña manages to assert herself to the journalist as a working woman.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Claudia returns to work under pressure from Ramona, who doesn't know she's pregnant. Digna and Damián have a romantic dinner. Luz and Jaime have a great time together.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Begoña, saddened by the publication of the report, decides to empower herself and return to the cabin. Jaime suggests to Luz that they break up so she won't have to take care of him.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Jaime confesses to Marta his relationship with Luz and she decides to talk to the doctor.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: María discovers Begoña and Andrés suspiciously close to each other, and Damián decides to take matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Despite Andrés' efforts to help Begoña with her mother, he must distance himself from Begoña.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Jesús agrees to let Begoña visit her mother in the sanatorium. Andrés continues to strengthen his commitment to María when he discovers Mercedes's condition.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Damián and the others welcome Patricia Lambert... will they reach an agreement? Luz notes María's strange behavior during her pregnancy follow-up.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Damián, feeling guilty about Valentín's death, makes an important decision regarding Digna. Jesús reproaches Begoña for neglecting her duties.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Digna has her first moment as a grandmother with Julia. Andrés visits Mercedes to support Begoña. Jesús blackmails Patricia during the negotiations.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Begoña turns to pills to cope with her mother's funeral. Marta vents to Fina about Patricia Lambert and praises Isabel.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: After discovering Andrés about to kiss Begoña, María can't hold it in any longer and tells Jesús. Luis doesn't want to be part of the resort project.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Jesús learns that Begoña is taking pills. Andrés continues to investigate Valentín's death. Despite Joaquín's disdain, Gema wants to prove that she will remain by his side.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Jaime gives in to the blackmail and corroborates María's lie. Isabel surprises Marta and Fina as they leave the recital.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: María and Jesús blame Begoña for everything that has happened to them. Don Agustín learns that Claudia and Mateo spent the night outside the colony.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Isabel defends Jesús' position, and Martha is surprised. Begoña feels bad seeing Andrés's dedication to his marriage.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: After what happened with Jesús the night before, and with Andrés closer to María, Begoña eases her pain with more pills. Claudia tries to clear the air with Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Jesús denies having forced Begoña. She makes an irreversible decision. Luis and Luz argue. They won't be able to keep his illness a secret from Marta much longer.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Damián intercedes to prevent Begoña's accusation from reaching fruition. Jesús, powerless in the face of his wife's behavior, locks her up.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Jaime notices a rapprochement between Luz and Luis, which leads him to make an important decision.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Jesús begins to drug Begoña to manipulate her and make her believe that his plan to go live in London for a while is viable.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Some members of the main house notice Begoña's strange behavior: Jesús's plan is working.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Andrés and Luz begin to suspect Begoña's strange behavior. María suggests holding a party for the company's thirtieth anniversary.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Damián tries to strengthen ties with the Merino family. Gema and Isabel clash over the management of the festival preparations.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: The resort's progress distracts Gema from her obligations to the fair. Begoña, a victim of Jesús's manipulation, truly doubts her sanity.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Begoña, in full delirium, accuses Jesús of the murder of Valentín and Clotilde in front of the Merino family.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: The rumor of Claudia's pregnancy spreads through the neighborhood and brings her serious problems.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Jesús has the upper hand with Jaime: if he wants Marta to avoid jail, he'll have to keep quiet.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Digna and Jaime discover Luz and Luis having an intimate moment. Begoña, guided by suspicion and convinced by Andrés's support, tries to uncover what Jesús is plotting.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Jesús confesses to Damián that he's drugging Begoña. Marta arranges for Fina to accompany her to the awards ceremony.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Luz tries to dissuade Begoña from taking Julia along with her escape plan. Joaquín disapproves of Gema's relationship with Isabel and asks her to take action.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Begoña needs passports to leave the country, but she doesn't want help from anyone. Pressured by Joaquín, Gema must make a decision regarding her relationship with Isabel.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Luz confesses to Andrés what's happening with Jesús and Begoña. Fina reveals to Isidro who her lover is before he finds out from third parties.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Guilt has taken its toll on Jesús, who seems to want to stop drugging Begoña. Begoña reveals her plans to escape to Julia and asks her to keep it a secret.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: The Merino family continues its search for information about who beat them to the purchase of the resort lands.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Jesús manipulates Julia to turn her against Begoña. Encouraged by Luz, Digna motivates her children not to abandon the resort project.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Begoña tells Digna that Jesús has taken their land. Tasio suggests a solution to Carmen's case to get money for the apartment she's always wanted.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Damián scolds Jesús for buying the Merino land. Gema understands that Isabel used her to spy on them. She apologizes to Joaquín and demands an explanation.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Marta tries to convince Jaime to go public with his illness. Jesús is going to take Julia to the boarding school and prevents Begoña from accompanying them.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: With Julia located, Jesús doesn't give in: he won't delay his departure. Claudia has many doubts about being a single mother and leans on Luz for support.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Begoña doesn't forgive Jesús for separating her from Julia. After her conversation with Mario, Digna renounces the memory of Gervasio.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Andrés suspects the whereabouts of Valentín's body. Jesús begins to put things together and thinks he understands why Jaime threw the glass at him.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Begoña still can't see Julia because of Jesús. Damián and Digna invite the two families together for a meal. What do they have to announce?

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Damián confronts Jesús about his son's reaction to the news of the wedding. To show her support for the wedding, Gema makes a nice gesture toward Digna.

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Begoña reveals to Andrés the progress she has made in the investigation into Valentín's murder. Damián and Begoña say goodbye to Jaime in his final hours.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: Andrés tells Begoña what he discovered on the Camino de la Sagra. Digna senses Andrés's reluctance to marry.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Andrés doesn't forgive María for faking her pregnancy and tells Begoña the truth. Jesús torpedoes the correspondence between Julia and Begoña.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Andrés continues the investigation and tests Isidro to see what he knows. Jesús, in his own unique way, digs up dirt on Mario.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Jesús loses his temper with Digna over Damián's decision to include her in his will. María doesn't know what to do to get Andrés to forgive her.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: Begoña and Digna act on their own to contact Julia. After what she did, Andrés asks María to accept the new reality of their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Damián officially replaces Jesús with Martha as the factory's manager. Jesús feels humiliated, and Isabel tries to get closer to Martha again.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: Mateo, heartbroken over Claudia, says goodbye to the people of the neighborhood. Meanwhile, she refuses to let him leave. Gema helps Digna get ready for the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 154
videos.overview: Claudia radiates happiness about her future plans with Mateo, but he needs Don Agustín's approval.

videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: María confesses to Don Agustín and asks him for advice on how to fix her relationship with Andrés.

videos.title: Episode 156
videos.overview: Damián informs Marta of Luis's resignation and she cannot hide her disappointment.

videos.title: Episode 157
videos.overview: Carmen questions whether it is unfair not to hire Jacinto just because he is a man, while Marta tries to negotiate with Luis to bring back the formula.

videos.title: Episode 158
videos.overview: Damián rebukes Andrés for what happened with Begoña and he tries to defend himself.

videos.title: Episode 159
videos.overview: Fina misses Marta and lets Isidro know. Begoña misses Julia and plans to visit her at boarding school.

videos.title: Episode 160
videos.overview: Tensions between Begoña and María rise again after another clash, and Mateo, increasingly desperate, continues looking for work.

videos.title: Episode 161
videos.overview: Joaquín boasts to Jesús about his new position as owner of Perfumerías De la Reina. Carmen makes it clear to Tasio that she won't tolerate his jealousy over the clerk.

videos.title: Episode 162
videos.overview: Begoña tells Digna what happened with Julia and seeks her help. She speaks to Damián to ask for his help.

videos.title: Episode 163
videos.overview: Luis suggests that Andrés also opt for an annulment. Fina asks Claudia for help with the shift change, and she tries to talk Jacinto into giving in.

videos.title: Episode 164
videos.overview: Begoña teams up with Digna to win Julia back and opens up to her about her situation with Andrés. Tasio learns about the new management structure of the company.

videos.title: Episode 165
videos.overview: Jesús, aware of her plans with Andrés, attacks Begoña. Mateo discovers that Gaspar is sacrificing his own money to keep him on his contract.

videos.title: Episode 166
videos.overview: Jesús has made the evidence of Valentín's murder disappear, but Andrés doesn't intend to give up his search. Damián, fearful of what he might know, probes Isidro.

videos.title: Episode 167
